ListenRoom.title: ListenRoom
ListenRoom.description: A real-time Listen Together music synchronization room identified by a shareable room code.

roomCode.description: Shareable 4-12 character uppercase room sync code matching the document ID.

hostUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the user who created the room.

hostUsername.description: Display username of the room host (2-30 chars).

roomName.description: Title of the Listen Together session (1-60 chars).

active.description: Whether the room is currently active; transitions to false as a terminal closed state.

memberUids.description: Bounded list (max 20) of authenticated user UIDs currently connected to the room.

memberNames.description: Map of authenticated user UID to chosen display username (max 20 entries).

trackId.description: Unique track identifier currently loaded in the room.

trackTitle.description: Title of the currently synced song.

trackArtist.description: Artist name of the currently synced song.

trackAlbum.description: Album name of the currently synced song.

trackArtworkUrl.description: Artwork image URL for the synced song.

trackDurationMs.description: Duration of the synced song in milliseconds.

trackStreamUrl.description: Optional direct stream URL for radio or direct providers.

playing.description: Whether playback is currently playing or paused.

positionMs.description: Playback position in milliseconds at playbackUpdatedAtMs.

playbackUpdatedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when playback state or seek position last changed.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the member who last updated room playback.

updatedByUsername.description: Username of the member who last updated room playback.

createdAt.description: Immutable room creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last room update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/listen_rooms/{roomCode}.description: Real-time Listen Together rooms synced across devices using a unique room code.
